subject: Record of processing activities exception threshold
text: The Federal Council shall provide exceptions for legal entities that have fewer than 250 employees and whose data processing poses a negligible risk of harm to the personality of the data subjects.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Deadline to inform where data are not collected from the data subject
text: the controller shall also inform the data subject of the information specified in paragraphs 2-4 at the latest one month after receiving the data
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

value: two months, extendable by one month
subject: FDPIC deadline to notify objections after consultation
text: The FDPIC shall inform the controller within two months of any objections to the planned processing. This deadline may be extended by one month if the data processing is complex.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Notification of a breach of data security to the FDPIC
text: The controller shall notify the FDPIC of any breach of data security that is likely to lead to a high risk to the data subject's personality or fundamental rights as quickly as possible.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Processor notification of a breach of data security to the controller
text: The processor shall notify the controller of any breach of data security as quickly as possible.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Deadline to provide information on a right-to-information request
text: The information shall in general be provided within 30 days.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Maximum age of creditworthiness data
text: The data are no more than ten years old.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Evaluation report on a pilot trial
text: The competent federal body shall submit an evaluation report to the Federal Council no later than two years after the start of the pilot trial.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Maximum duration of a pilot trial without a formal enactment
text: Automated data processing must in every case be discontinued if no formal enactment containing the required legal basis has come into force within five years of the start of the pilot trial.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

value: four years, may be extended twice
subject: Commissioner's term of office
text: The Commissioner's term of office amounts to four years and may be extended twice.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Termination of the Commissioner's employment contract
text: The Commissioner may terminate his or her employment contract at the end of any month subject to a period of six months' notice.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Statute of limitations for prosecution
text: Prosecution is subject to a statute of limitations of five years.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf

subject: Transitional period for the data of legal entities
text: For federal bodies, regulations in other federal legislation that relate to personal data shall continue to apply to the data of legal entities for five years from the date on which this Act come into force.
source_document: KB 2/Switzerland/Switzerland Revised Federal Act on Data Protection.pdf
